ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels. Ventral surface is approximately 97% low-intensity pixels with scattered high-intensity highlights from specular reflection and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity region across the entire fluke surface. Isolated high-intensity linear clusters and micro-spots are sparsely mapped across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees; vertical depth of notch is roughly 12% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration across the entire continuous trailing edge; peaks and valleys range from 5 to 25 pixels in depth, with maximum irregularity observed at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Highly concave upward sweep trajectory along the outer lobe edges, transitioning from a shallow curve near the notch to an steep vertical orientation at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse detection of small (2-5 pixel radius) high-intensity circular clusters localized primarily along the lower trailing edge of the left lobe and the central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct set of parallel, vertically-oriented high-intensity linear streaks (rake-like marks) visible on the right lobe's surface, crossing the mid-region toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel loss and extreme jaggedness at both distal fluke tips, indicating substantial physical trauma or erosion of the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity focal point (white spot) located on the left lobe, approximately 15 pixels distal from the base of the median notch.
